Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939)
I agree with [Miss Sewell ](../persons.html#1301)as to the alteration, otherwise it will do very nicely. I hope to be at home on the 1st or 2nd of June[^2]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.

[^2]: The book in question must have been [European History](../books.html#82) (1870).
